description: This file defines the Net_URL class in PHP which provides functionalities for parsing, constructing, and manipulating URLs including query string handling, path resolving, and protocol management.

classes.name: Net_URL
classes.description: A class for parsing and manipulating URLs in PHP, including components like protocol, host, port, path, query string, and anchor, with methods to modify query parameters and resolve paths.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the URL components by parsing the given URL.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes URL components based on either the current server environment or a provided URL.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Constructs and returns the full URL string from its components.

methods.name: addQueryString
methods.description: Adds or updates a query string parameter, encoding it if necessary.

methods.name: removeQueryString
methods.description: Removes a specific query string parameter.

methods.name: addRawQueryString
methods.description: Sets the query string directly from a raw string.

methods.name: getQueryString
methods.description: Returns the query string component assembled from key-value pairs.

methods.name: _parseRawQuerystring
methods.description: Parses a raw query string into an array of key-value pairs, handling bracket notation.

methods.name: resolvePath
methods.description: Resolves path segments like '.' and '..' in URL paths to produce a simplified path.

methods.name: getStandardPort
methods.description: Returns the default port number associated with a given URL scheme.

methods.name: setProtocol
methods.description: Sets the URL's protocol and optionally its port.

methods.name: setOption
methods.description: Sets an option for URL encoding, such as whether to encode query keys.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified option.
